MOD4_rules: Use the existing MJCF/URDF dynamic-body list as the aggregation boundary; do not force MOD4 into Fudan7links.
Merge all CAD components rigidly fixed together and assign one group mass, center of mass, and inertia tensor.
Retain independently moving passive members and loop-closure bodies; do not collapse an entire closed-chain leg to one rigid body.
Assign motor housings/stators, fixed gearbox cases, bolts and bearings to their mounting rigid body; rotating wheel/output members to the corresponding rotating body.
Use measured/OEM motor total masses as group corrections without separately counting imported rotor/stator aliases; use armature for rotor reflected inertia when modeling it.
Treat batteries and electronics fixed to the chassis as part of the base rigid body, except any deliberately articulated gimbal.
Verify large known nominal changes in grouped mass/COM/inertia first, then apply coherent body-level DR to remaining uncertainty. Do not useDR to conceal an already known material or payload change.
Small hardware need not have individual verified mass inputs if their grouped properties are captured; preserve a reasonable residual uncertainty budget.
